summary.text: Joseph Steinberger is a certified write-in candidate for U.S. Senate in Maine on the Faith in Humanity Party line, listed by Spectrum News as living in Rockland. No campaign website, statements or Ballotpedia survey were found.

paragraphs.text: Listed as a Faith in Humanity candidate from Rockland on the list of declared write-in candidates reported by Spectrum News; Ballotpedia has no biographical information.

sources.title: Maine's U.S. Senate race to include 6 write-in candidates, triggering ranked-choice voting
